# Continual-ARC puzzle solving

Use this procedure when handling a puzzle in a Continual-ARC stream.

Before submission, check that the returned grid has 1–30 nonempty rows of equal length, with only integer cell values 0–9; output dimensions need not equal the input dimensions.
